name: nitrosend
description: AI email marketing in Grok, with the same Nitrosend account you use in ChatGPT, Claude and Codex. Ask your agent to build an email Brand Kit from your website, then write, design and send newsletters, email campaigns, automated email flows (welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back) and transactional emails, and reply from shared agent inboxes. Import contacts from Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo or any CSV, connect Shopify, HubSpot and Attio, and send through Nitrosend or your own SendGrid, Amazon SES, Postmark, Resend or Mailgun account. Hosted MCP server, OAuth sign-in, no API key, free to start.
